Landlord Instruction Sheet
Termination Notice — Landlord Confirmation
Workflow A — Written Statement
Your property manager has started a Termination Notice. You will receive a link by email or SMS to complete and sign a short form. No documents to upload — just complete the form, complete the written statement, and sign.
Steps to complete
1
Open the link from your email or SMS
Email comes from no-reply@reiformslive.com.au. An SMS link may also be sent. Both open the same form — no login needed.
SMS link (left) and email (right)
Check spam / junk if you don't see it
2
Click Get Started on the welcome page
Welcome page — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
3
Complete the Written Statement — be specific
Scroll to the Written Statement section. Tick Yes and complete the written statement in the text box.
Written Statement — tick Yes and fill in the text box
!
Include the full name and relationship. E.g. "I am the landlord and will reside at the premises for at least 6 months" or "My daughter Sarah Smith will reside."
4
Click Complete → Yes, Complete
Click Complete top right. The dialog mentions uploading — for this workflow there is nothing to upload. Click Yes, Complete.
Complete Request dialog
5
Sign the document electronically
You are redirected to Forms Live Sign. Click Get Started → Start tab → Sign Here. Choose Standard or Draw, confirm your name, click Adopt Signature, then Complete.
Sign Here — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
Document Signing Complete
✓
Done. Your property manager is notified automatically.

Termination Notice — Landlord Confirmation
Workflow B — Upload Request (Agent uploads)
Your property manager has started a Termination Notice. You will receive a link by email or SMS. Your property manager will upload the required documents on your behalf. When you see the upload prompt, click Close — then complete the form and sign.
Steps to complete
1
Open the link from your email or SMS
SMS link (left) and email (right)
Check spam / junk if you don't see it
2
Click Get Started on the welcome page
Welcome page — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
3
An Upload Documents prompt appears — click Close
Do not upload anything. Your property manager is handling this. Click Close.
Upload Documents dialog — click Close (bottom right)
!
Click Close — not Upload. Your agent will attach the documents.
4
Scroll through the form and click Complete → Yes, Complete
Complete Request dialog
5
Sign the document electronically
Click Get Started → Start tab → Sign Here. Choose Standard or Draw, confirm your name, click Adopt Signature, then Complete.
Sign Here — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
Document Signing Complete
✓
Done. Your property manager is notified and will upload the documents.

Landlord Instruction Sheet
Termination Notice — Landlord Confirmation
Workflow C — Upload Request (You upload)
Your property manager has started a Termination Notice. You will receive a link by email or SMS. You will be asked to upload a supporting document. Please have it ready and redact any private information before uploading.
Steps to complete
1
Open the link from your email or SMS
SMS link (left) and email (right)
Check spam / junk if you don't see it
2
Click Get Started on the welcome page
Welcome page — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
3
Upload your supporting document
An Upload Documents dialog appears listing what is required. Click Choose File, select your document, name it, then click Upload. Wait for confirmation before continuing.
Upload Documents dialog — Choose File then Upload
⚠ Before uploading — redact private information. Remove or black out: bank account numbers, signatures of other parties, and private contact details. A black rectangle drawn over the text in any PDF editor or photo app is sufficient.
Example: purchase price and property address are relevant. BSB/account numbers           are not.
4
Scroll through the form and click Complete → Yes, Complete
Complete Request dialog
5
Sign the document electronically
Click Get Started → Start tab → Sign Here. Choose Standard or Draw, confirm your name, click Adopt Signature, then Complete.
Sign Here — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
Document Signing Complete
✓
Done. Your property manager is notified automatically.
